name: Cryonic-Holm
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by a subterranean ocean, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Remnant spores persist in sheltered niches, a biosphere's last stubborn embers, awaiting conditions that may never return.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.

For traders, nitrogen, carbon, dark crystals and helium-3 alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
